evals.prompt: Run a security audit of the iOS app in ~/Documents/git/knmi-app-ios (current checkout).
evals.expected_output: Public weather app without user accounts: the audit should say which areas do not apply instead of padding findings. Reads project instructions first. Covers every area in security.md and lists each area as checked with findings, checked without findings, or not applicable, with the search used as evidence. Traces each hit to whether it is reachable before classifying it with the company labels (security-violation, request-for-change, optional); does not report default-redacted Logger interpolation, test-only code, or third-party package internals as app findings. Redacts secret values. Edits nothing and does not build. States the MAS profiles: L1 and P, with L2 not applicable because there are no accounts or sensitive data, and R not requested. Reports a status for every MASVS 2.1 control, cites the MASVS control and MASTG test on each finding, and lists in-scope runtime and binary MASTG tests under Not checked instead of passing them. Does not contact an advisory service unless allowed.
